source.authors: Scholz, Barruol, Fontaine, Sigloch, Crawford and Deen
source.title: Orienting ocean-bottom seismometers from P-wave and Rayleigh wave polarizations
source.orientation_definition: clockwise from geographic north to BH1 in the paper's standardized convention
source.native_frame_caveat: The paper identifies different raw-to-SEED handedness for INSU-IPGP and DEPAS/GEOMAR in its supporting-information description. The exact mapping to this local archive was not independently established.

decision: Use as cited external orientation evidence, not as an automatic XML replacement or proof of pressure/vertical calibration. Relative-basis projection testing does not require a geographic rotation.
